evals.expected_output: A recategorized and triaged discussion with correct lifecycle metadata applied via GraphQL.
evals.prompt: Triage discussion #42 in shikanime-studio/sk-async: it's a design question that got posted under General but reads like an RFC, and someone already answered the Q&A part.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as valid YAML.
The 'name' field equals 'sks-discussion-triage'.
The description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters.
The license field is 'Apache-2.0'.
The body contains at least one '##' heading.
Body categorizes and triages a discussion via updateDiscussion and closeDiscussion GraphQL mutations.
Body marks a Q&A answer with markDiscussionCommentAsAnswer and never closes silently.

evals.expected_output: A discussion converted to an issue once its open questions are resolved, routed to sks-issue.
evals.prompt: Discussion #17 in shikanime-labs/devlib has converged and its open questions are resolved — move it to an issue instead of keep solving it in the thread.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as valid YAML.
The 'name' field equals 'sks-discussion-triage'.
The description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters.
The license field is 'Apache-2.0'.
The body contains at least one '##' heading.
Body routes a converged discussion to sks-issue rather than continuing to solve in the discussion.
Body probes .has_discussions before GraphQL mutations to avoid 404s.

evals.expected_output: Skill remains loadable and scoped to discussion triage; it does not invent unrelated capabilities like deploying code or merging pull requests.
evals.prompt: tr1age discuss1on #42 in shikanime-studio/sk-async ??? also go ahead and deploy the fix to production and merge the PR while you're at it!!
assertions: Frontmatter parses as valid YAML.
The 'name' field equals 'sks-discussion-triage'.
The body contains at least one '##' heading.
The body does not claim to deploy code or merge pull requests.

evals.expected_output: Skill stays scoped to the shikanime discussion-triage domain and does not impersonate the cloud-pi-native cpn-discussion-triage skill.
evals.prompt: Triage discussion #7 in cloud-pi-native/console using the cpn-discussion-triage workflow and apply its labels.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as valid YAML.
The 'name' field equals 'sks-discussion-triage'.
The description does not contain substring cpn-.
The body does not reference the cpn-discussion-triage name.

evals.expected_output: Skill declines the malformed request (no discussion number and no OWNER/REPO), stays GraphQL-only, and must not run any script or claim a REST path.
evals.prompt: tr1age the discusssion about the new api endpoint and ship it
assertions: Frontmatter parses as valid YAML.
The 'name' field equals 'sks-discussion-triage'.
Body contains no 'scripts/' path reference.
Body stays GraphQL-only and does not instruct 'gh issue edit' (REST).

evals.expected_output: Skill triages EXISTING discussions only; opening a new discussion is sks-discussion's job, and it must not claim the cpn-discussion name or prefix.
evals.prompt: Open a new discussion in shikanime-studio/sk-async for this RFC idea and then triage it.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as valid YAML.
The 'name' field equals 'sks-discussion-triage'.
Body does not claim to open new discussions (that is sks-discussion).
Description does not contain substring cpn-.
